changes.before: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.
changes.after: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up the Electric-type moves of Pokémon on the ground by 30% and prevents them from falling asleep. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

changes.before: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
changes.after: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves. Opposing Pokémon that land on these spikes when switching into battle will be poisoned. A second layer of spikes will instead badly poison. Poison-types that land on these spikes will absorb and remove them from the field.

changes.before: Ground-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore ¼ of its max HP.
changes.after: Ground-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

changes.before: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring ¼ of its ally’s max HP.
changes.after: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring 1/4 of its ally’s max HP.

changes.before: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing ¼ of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.
changes.after: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

changes.before: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s EXP. Points.
changes.after: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s Exp. Points.

changes.before: Weighs EXP. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.
changes.after: Weighs Exp. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

changes.before: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total EXP.
changes.after: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total Exp.

changes.before: Increases gain of EXP. Points by 25%.
changes.after: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 25%.

changes.before: Increases gain of EXP. Points by 60%.
changes.after: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 60%.

changes.before: Increases gain of EXP. Points by 100%.
changes.after: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 100%.

changes.before: Increases the holder’s gain of EXP. Points by 40%.
changes.after: Increases the holder’s gain of Exp. Points by 40%.

changes.before: Increases the holder’s gain of EXP. Points by 100%.
changes.after: Increases the holder’s gain of Exp. Points by 100%.
